$comment: Download centre. kind: download = an actual file (template, PDF); page = a web page to read; portal = a page where you act (register, submit); tool = an external helper. Files are linked at their official location and never re-hosted. 'status' mirrors the matching source's check result.

resources.title: STAGE-ONE Template (ARO_Submission.docx)
resources.purpose: The manuscript template for your first submission: first-page tick boxes, author fields, formatting, and the reference examples.
resources.howTo: Open the link, then File → Download → Microsoft Word (.docx). The Google Docs page needs a browser with JavaScript.

resources.title: ARO template (ARO_Template.dotx)
resources.purpose: The template file the Guide to Authors links to as 'STAGE ONE TEMPLATE'. A Word template (.dotx) that creates a new document from it.
resources.howTo: Open the link and use Drive's download button. Compare it with ARO_Submission.docx; the Submissions checklist links to the .docx.
